method: scripts/production-baseline/fingerprint.sql run read-only against production (Supabase MCP) and against a fresh replay of the 411 migrations production has applied; per-table and per-function hashes compared, then each differing object read in full
result: production matches the replay except the items below

drift.finding: production lacks the paperwork filter; 20260825120000_photo_records was edited after it was applied
exists only in production (1,633 rows); no migration creates it, though applied functions read it
drift.action: carried by a baseline built from a production dump

drift.finding: role arc_outreach_app, policy outreach_app_all on three tables and their grants exist only in production
buckets project-files, org-logos, drawings-images, drawings-tiles and four project-files policies on storage.objects were made outside migrations
columns were added in a different order
identical apart from comments and whitespace (applied through the MCP without them)

dump_finding: a Supabase CLI dump restored into a Supabase database takes the platform default privileges, granting anon and authenticated access to service-only functions and tables; build.cjs clears them before the dump and the dump restores them
baseline_proof: a baseline built from the replay dump plus the drift above, replayed alone, matched production's catalog per table, per function and per grant, apart from the Supabase storage triggers; with it in place of the 411 files the 95-file set replayed to the unconsolidated schema plus exactly the production-only objects, and SCHEMA-01 passed (623 assertions)
